seo.title: Recent Jobs — Cedar Mill Plumbing
seo.description: A look at recent plumbing jobs across Cedar Mill, Bethany, Beaverton, and NW Portland — repipes, water heater installs, hydro jetting, and leak repairs.

header.heading: Recent Jobs
header.lead: A few recent jobs across the Westside — open subfloor with new PEX, copper-to-PEX repipes, tankless conversions, and the occasional sewer scope that turned into a real fix.

emptyState.heading: Job photos coming soon
emptyState.body: I'm slowly publishing photo write-ups of finished jobs — what the situation was, what I found, what got installed, and what it cost. Check back over the next few months, or call if you want to see a similar job to yours.

cta.heading: Looking for a similar job to yours?
cta.body: If you've got a project in mind and want to see how a comparable one went — what got installed, how long it took, what it cost — call or send a quick form. I keep photos on every job and I'm happy to walk through one.
